introduction: Pennsylvania TANF helps eligible pregnant participants and families caring for dependent children meet basic needs.
description: Pennsylvania TANF helps eligible pregnant participants and families caring for dependent children meet basic needs.

sections.who: The county assistance office checks income, resources, residence, status and family relationships. Child and work-participation rules apply, with case-specific exceptions.
sections.get: Temporary cash support is available under program rules. The state describes a usual lifetime limit of 60 months.
sections.docs:
• Family and child relationship information.
  • Income and resource evidence.
  • Requested identity, status and Social Security records.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use COMPASS or return the state application to your county assistance office.

  2. Discuss a plan

    Complete the Agreement of Mutual Responsibility with your caseworker, including any participation barriers.

  3. Review the notice

    Check the decision, duties and application status at trackmybenefits.pa.gov.
sections.after: Discuss work, child care, transport or health changes with the worker. Ask about related support when cash assistance ends.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Pennsylvania TANF. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: The program includes eligible relatives caring for dependent children.
The state lists a usual lifetime limit of five years.
It records the plan and responsibilities agreed with the caseworker.
Tell the worker and ask about applicable exceptions or support.
